title: Gurubashi Arena
wikitext: The Bloodsail Pirates have a penchant for illicit after-hours activities, especially those involving mass combat and treasure. To see that his crew has its nightly fill of extracurricular entertainment, a lone pirate captain will drop a chest in the center of Gurubashi Arena starting at midnight, and again every three hours so at '''3 AM, 6 AM, 9 AM, 12 PM, 3 PM, 6 PM, 9 PM''' and back to midnight the chest drops. The Gurubashi Arena is a free-for-all PvP area located in Stranglethorn Vale just north of Booty Bay. ==Rewards== Within [https://database.turtle-wow.org/?object=179697 Arena Treasure Chest] adventurers can frequently find Superior Healing Potions, Greater Healing Potions, Greater Mana Potion and Mana Potions. Rare as well as uncommon equipment can also be found inside the chest. Some notable equipment exclusive to the treasure chest are: {| class="fandom-table" !Item !Quality !Type |- |[https://database.turtle-wow.org/?item=18711 Arena Bands] |Rare |Mail Wrist |- |[https://database.turtle-wow.org/?item=18710 Arena Bracers] |Rare |Leather Wrist |- |[https://database.turtle-wow.org/?item=18712 Arena Vambraces] |Rare |Plate Wrist |- |[https://database.turtle-wow.org/?item=18709 Arena Wristguards] |Rare |Cloth Wrist |- |[https://database.turtle-wow.org/?item=18706 Arena Master] |Uncommon |Trinket |} In addition, through the quests [https://database.turtle-wow.org/?quest=7810 Arena Master] and [https://database.turtle-wow.org/?quest=7838 Arena Grand Master], the rare trinket [https://database.turtle-wow.org/?item=19024 Arena Grand Master] can be obtained. Adventurers must hand in 12 [https://database.turtle-wow.org/?item=18706 Arena Masters] to [https://database.turtle-wow.org/?npc=14508 Short John Mithril] inside the arena to obtain the rare trinket. Note that the [https://database.turtle-wow.org/?item=19024 Arena Grand Master] rare trinket has no level requirements, and therefore makes for an excellent twink item. Both the [https://database.turtle-wow.org/?item=19024 Arena Grand Master] and the [https://database.turtle-wow.org/?item=18706 Arena Master], however, are bind on pickup.
